The structure of Cu₂AgAu crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 16-atom unit cell (Cu₈Ag₄Au₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner, edge, and face sharing between Cu-centered eight-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Ag- and Au-centered polyhedra.
